title: Financial Engineering
text:
Financial Engineering, is an unique inter-disciplinary Dual Degree program offering a B.Tech (Hons.) in any core engineering stream followed by M.Tech in Financial Engineering. The course was introduced in 2010 to meet the demands of engineers equipped with advanced mathematical and computational skills and knowledge in different fields of financial products and markets. The course is jointly coordinated by Vinod Gupta School of Management.
